a: Teyasoma, era obwetaavu obwo yabuwulira obulamu bwe bwonna. Bwe yali yeetegekedde Oxford ng'amaze essomero, mu kifo ky'ekyo yasindikibwa okusomera mu kyama mu Ludlow Castle, era yunivasite gye yayagala teyajja n'akatono. Yeeyigiriza yekka n'obunyiikivu obw'amaanyi era nga tewali nteekateeka, ng'amanyi nti obutaba na bitiibwa bya ttendekero kyandimufudde "Anyoomebwa abasinga obungi" — era n'okukyuka kwe kwajja mu ngeri y'emu, okuyita mu bitabo ebyali bimaze okukozesebwa abalala ebyatuuka ku luggi lwa kitaawe so si mu mubuulizi yenna, ne kiba nti obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo yeesiganga ebitabo ebyakubibwa okutuuka gy'ataasobolanga kutuuka ye yennyini.

q: Kituufu nti yali mulwadde obulamu bwe obusinga?
a: Okumala emyaka nga ataano Baxter yeetikka endwadde abasawo be ze bataasobola kutuuma linnya wadde okuziwonya — okuvaamu omusaayi mu nnyindo okw'amaanyi kwe yalowooza nti kwava ku mayinja mu nsigo, olubuto olwayonooneka, n'ekyo kye yayita obukadde obw'amangu. Yatandika kumpi buli kitabo ng'asuubira obutawangaala kukimaliriza, era ekyo yakikyamiramu okumala ekitundu ky'ekyasa. Mu kimu ku biseera ebyo eby'okuyongobera okwali kumpi okumutta, ng'aweweera ewala n'awaka ng'alina Bayibuli ye yokka, mwe yawandiikira The Saints' Everlasting Rest ng'okufumiitiriza kw'omuntu afa ku ggulu.

q: Kiki ekyafuula obuweereza bwe e Kidderminster okumanyibwa ennyo?
a: Ng'ayitiddwa mu 1641 mu kibuga ky'abaluzi eky'obulagajjavu ekyalimu amaka nga lunaana, ekyamanyibwa olw'obutamiivu n'obutamanya, Baxter yamala emyaka amakumi abiri ng'akikyusa. Bwe yali ava, yabala abaali basaanira okulya ku mmeeza ya Mukama lukaaga mu maka ago, ekkuŋŋaaniro lyali lisukkiridde obunene bw'ekizimbe, era ku Ssande wandiwulidde enguudo zonna nga ziyimba zabbuli era nga zikomawo ku kubuulira mu nnyumba zaabwe. Gye yasanga ng'amaka gamu gokka mu luguudo agaasinza Katonda, yaleka enguudo omutaali kumpi maka na limu agataasinza.

q: Yasobola atya okulunda abantu abangi bwe batyo kinnoomu?
a: Baxter yali akakasiza ddala nti okubuulira kwokka tekwandimazeeyo, bw'atyo ye n'omuyambi we ne bateekawo ennaku bbiri buli wiiki ne batwala amaka kkumi na ana omulundi gumu, nga bayita mu kitundu kyonna ky'ekkanisa amaka ku maka n'oluvannyuma ne batandika okuddamu. Okuva mu mpisa eyo mwe mwava The Reformed Pastor (1656), ekyafuula okuyigiriza katekisimu amaka ku maka n'obugumiikiriza ekyokulabirako eky'Ekipuritani mu kifo ky'okubeera ekintu eky'ekyewuunyo. Yagaana okukuŋŋaanya abo bokka abaali beetegefu mu kkuŋŋaaniro erirondeddwa, ng'agamba mu bwerufu nti: "Ndowooza nti Omulimu gw'Ekitundu ky'Ekkanisa gwe gusinga obulungi."

q: Yakola ki mu Lutalo olw'omunda mu Bungereza?
a: Baxter teyayagala kubeera mu lutalo n'akatono naye yasikibwa mu lwo, n'aweereza ng'omusumba w'eggye ery'okukuuma e Coventry n'oluvannyuma ow'ekibinja kya Kanoni Edward Whalley oluvannyuma lwa Naseby. Yagendanga mu kuzingiza ebibuga naye teyalwana, era kye yasanga mu ggye kyamutiisa: ab'ebitundu eby'eddiini ebitonotono nga bawakanya buli njigiriza okutuusa lwe zaamenyekamenyeka, era yamala obusumba bwe ng'agezaako okubakomyawo n'ensonga. Okuvaamu omusaayi mu nnyindo okw'akabi kwakomya obuweereza bwe mu 1647, era oluvannyuma n'abala nti Katonda yali amuggye mu ggye nga eggye terinnamutta.

q: Lwaki yafiirwa ekifo kye eky'okubuuliriramu mu 1662?
a: Mu kudda kwa Kabaka ku ntebe, Baxter yakolerera endagaano engazi ekimala okukuuma Abapuritani abateefu munda mu Kkanisa ya Bungereza, era yagaana mu kasirise obulabirizi bw'e Hereford bwe yaweebwa. Etteeka ery'Obumu bwe lyalagira buli muweereza okukkiriza ebiragiro nga tewannaba kutuuka ku Lunaku lwa Bartolomayo Omutukuvu mu 1662, teyasobola, era n'afuluma mu Great Ejection wamu n'abalala kumpi enkumi bbiri. Yali aweza emyaka amakumi ana mu mukaaga, era teyaddayo kufuna kitundu kya kkanisa nate.

q: Olugero lw'omusango gwe mu maaso g'Omulamuzi Jeffreys lwa mazima?
a: Lwa mazima, era si lugero wabula byafaayo ebiwandiikiddwa. Mu 1685, ng'aweza emyaka nkaaga mu mwenda era ng'amenyese mu mubiri, Baxter yawozesebwa olw'okuteeberezebwa nti yavvoola Ekkanisa ya Bungereza mu kitabo kye Paraphrase on the New Testament, mu maaso ga Sir George Jeffreys, Omulamuzi Omukulu. Jeffreys teyalina kigendererwa kya kuwulira musango mu bwenkanya; yavvoola omusajja omukadde ng'ali ku ntebe y'obulamuzi era teyakkiriza kwewozaako kwe yali yeetegese kuwulirwa. Baxter yasingibwa omusango, n'atanzibwa, era n'asibibwa okumala nga emyezi kkumi na munaana okutuusa engassi lwe yasonyiyibwa.

q: Obufumbo bwe ne Margaret Charlton bwali butya?
a: Margaret yali muwala omuvubuka ow'ekitiibwa, ow'amalala era ayagala ebyambalo eby'omulembe, eyakyusibwa omutima wansi w'okubuulira kwe e Kidderminster; baafumbiriganwa wiiki ssatu oluvannyuma lw'okugobwa kwe, bwe yali talina musaala era ng'amusinga emyaka nnyo. Obufumbo bwamala emyaka kkumi na mwenda era bwali, ng'ebiwandiiko byonna n'ebibye bwe biraga, bwa ssanyu erya njawulo, Margaret ng'atambuza obulamu bwabwe obw'akabi mu biseera by'okuyigganyizibwa. Bwe yafa mu 1681, yawandiika A Breviate of the Life of Margaret Baxter mu wiiki ntono — ekijjukizo ky'omwami akungubaga eky'obwerufu obungi ku birabo bye ne ku ngeri gye yamusinga mu magezi ag'okukola ebintu.

q: Yawandiika ki, era asinga kumanyibwa lwa ki?
a: Baxter yawandiika ebitabo nga kikumi mu nkaaga, omuwendo ogw'ekyewuunyo eri omusajja eyali omulwadde bw'atyo. Ebisinga okwagalibwa ye The Saints' Everlasting Rest, okufumiitiriza ku ggulu, ne A Call to the Unconverted, okukubiriza okwangu era okw'amangu okw'okubuulira Enjiri, so nga The Reformed Pastor kyabumba emirembe n'emirembe gy'abaweereza. Era ajjukirwa olw'ennyiriri ebbiri okuva mu Poetical Fragments (1681): "Nnabuulira, ng'atali mukakafu nti alibuulira nate, Era ng'omusajja afa eri abantu abafa!"

q: Baxter ye yayiiya ekigambo ku bumu mu bintu ebyetaagisa?
a: Mazima yakubiriza omusingi ogwo — "obumu mu bintu ebyetaagisa, eddembe mu bintu ebitali bya bwetaavu, n'okwagala mu byonna" — ng'omutima gw'okwegayirira kwe okw'obulamu bwe bwonna olw'emirembe mu Bapolotesitanti, wadde ng'ebigambo ebyo ebimanyiddwa bikadde okusinga Baxter era si ye yabiyiiya. Yali musajja anoonya emirembe eyamala obulamu bwe mu mpaka era yali akimanyi, ng'ayatula mu bukadde bwe nti abantu abalungi baali tebalungi, n'ababi tebaali babi, nga bwe yali alowooza edda. Bwe yabuuzibwa okumpi n'enkomerero nti awulira atya, yaddamu nti, "Kumpi mpulira bulungi"; yafa nga 8 December 1691, ng'aweza emyaka nsanvu mu mukaaga, era ab'ekkanisa enkulu n'Abawakanyi ne bajja ku kuziika kwe wamu.
